title: akbar ke janaze pe muje le chalo bhayya
body:
Akbar haye, haye akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye..
Haye jis waqt gira zeen se ham shakle payambar
shabbir ko zainab ne sadaa di ye tadapkar
Akbar..
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum milke utha lenge haye
hum milke utha lenge jawa'n laal ka lasha
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Atthara baras wale ka sar god mein lekar
mai naade ali padhti rahungi aye baradar
tum seena e akbar se nikaloge jo naiza
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jo zakhm lage hai wo dikhaega na tumko
shayad wo takalluf mein bataega na tumko
mai maa hu magar mujh se chupa hi nahi sakta
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mai janti hu kaise jawa'n hote hai bete aur dekhne pad jaye agar unke janaze
ab mai bhi samajh sakti hu aulad ka sadmaa
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Haye akbar..
Aane nahi dungi mai kisi ko bhi waha'n par
jee bhar ke gale milna jawa'n laal se jakar
mai maut se kehdungi zara der theher jaa
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baba mere baba ki sadaa de to raha hai
awaaz se lagta hai bohot door gira hai
lo haath mera thamo bohot door hai jaana
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haye Akbar..
Us karb ki halat se nikalega tumhe kaun
wo ediya'n ragdega, sambhalega tumhe kaun
chadar se bana lungi mai kuch der ko parda
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tooti hai kamar aapki aye mere baradar
gir gir ke uthenge to hasenge ye sitamgar
mai aapko banne ko nahi dungi tamasha
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Roti hai koi bibi musalsal pase parda
jab se hai suna mir takallum tera nauha
bhai se gale milke behen boli dobara
<<MINI>>
Akbar ke janaze pe mujhe le chalo bhaiyya..
Akbar.. haye haye akbar
